distribution: Local Debug build with the fixed framework, before preparing TestFlight build 15; release status in TESTFLIGHT.md.
rootCause: Cloak async_recv held the real OpenVPN global mutex during blocking receive; idle peer blocked TUN packets, timers and stop until a remote packet arrived.
fix: Remove the core mutex from background receive and its local exception handler. Preserve locking in the completion on the core event loop. Restore per-connection cancellation and lifetime fix missing from build 14.

regression.before: New test failed: idle Cloak receive blocked the core mutex
regression.after: Passed with the real bigmutex.hpp, ASan/UBSan and ThreadSanitizer

features: All app functions retained; all ten selected bypass services and 104 normalized routes preserved.
limitations: Tested on the connected iPhone network; Wi-Fi/cellular handover and an hour-long session were not exercised.
